title: Studio Rule on Building and Booking the Quote
content:
# Studio Rule on Building and Booking the Quote

## Clause 1: what the quoted total is built from

The quoted total for a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions is built from the design as approved, the metal chosen and the stones specified, and it holds at the metal price taken on the day the quote was built.

## Clause 2: the stage at which a quote is booked

The quote is booked to the commission only while it stands at consultation, design approval or deposit pending, because a quote answers a design and not a piece already being made. The stage is read from the commission record, correlated by its commission reference, before the quote is booked.

## Clause 3: the design fee

The design fee is charged where the programme charges one and credited against the quoted total on the programmes that credit it. The design fee is booked to the commission as its own entry under the design fee reason rather than folded into the quote, so that crediting it later leaves a visible pair of entries.

## Clause 4: expediting

Where a commission is expedited, the surcharge is the quoted total multiplied by the programme's rush surcharge rate as a percentage, rounded to two decimal places. The programme's minimum notice in calendar days and the business days expedited production runs to are the programme's own figures.

## Clauses no longer in force

Four sentences of the earlier wording of this rule have been superseded by the current basis and are **no longer in force**. They are recorded so that they are not applied:

> "Where the design has not been approved within the programme's metal price revaluation window in calendar days, counted from the date the metal price behind the quote was taken, the quote is rebuilt at the current metal price." — no longer in force. Under that retired clause the clock ran from the date the metal price behind the quote was taken as recorded on the commission, counted in whole calendar days with that day as day zero and weekends and market holidays included, the design having to be approved not later than the last day of the programme's window, a design approved on that last day being within it.

> "The revaluation window is counted in whole calendar days from the day the metal price was taken, that day counting as day zero, weekends and market holidays included." — no longer in force.

> "On the programmes that pass the metal market through, the difference between the old and the new metal price is charged as a price adjustment; on the programmes that do not, the chain absorbs it and no adjustment is booked." — no longer in force.

> "A stone sourced to order carries the programme's sourcing fee on the stone's cost, and the fee is shown as its own line rather than folded into the quote." — no longer in force.

## Illustration of clause 2 (hypothetical)

A commission standing at deposit pending may still have its quote booked; the same commission once it stands in production may not, because the quote answers a design and the piece is already being made.
